defensiveAbilities.name: Invasive Spores
defensiveAbilities.description:
10 feet. A vracinea constantly exudes sweet-smelling spores. Any creature that enters or starts its turn in the area must attempt a DC 18 Fortitude Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and immune to the vracinea's aura for 24 hours.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature is Clumsy 1 and Enfeebled 1 for 1 round.

Critical Failure As success, plus the creature is Paralyzed for 1 round.

offensiveAbilities.name: Blossom Lure
offensiveAbilities.description:
The vracinea's violet blossoms emit a magical glow that compels all onlookers to approach. Each non-vracinea creature within a 120ft Type:emanation must attempt a DC 21 Will Saving Throw save to avoid the lure. The effect lasts for 1 round, but the vracinea can Sustain this ability on subsequent rounds, extending the duration by 1 round for all affected creatures. Once a creature succeeds at any save against Blossom Lure, that creature is temporarily immune to Blossom Lure for 24 hours.

Success The creature is unaffected.

Failure The creature must spend each of its actions to move closer to the vracinea as expediently as possible while avoiding obvious dangers. If a lured creature is adjacent to the vracinea, it stays still and doesn't act. If a lured creature takes damage from any source or is targeted by an enemy with an attack or hostile effect, the creature is freed from this effect at the end of the current turn.

Critical Failure As failure, but if damaged, attacked, or targeted, the creature attempts a new save at the start of its next turn, rather than being automatically freed at the end of the current turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Feeding Frenzy
offensiveAbilities.description: The vracinea makes up to three jaws Strikes, each against a different target. These attacks count against the vracinea's multiple attack penalty, but the multiple attack penalty doesn't increase until after the vracinea makes all its attacks.
